title: Eugenio Chacarra Secures Two-Shot Victory at DP World India Championship
excerpt: Spanish golfer Eugenio Chacarra clinched the DP World India Championship by two strokes, claiming his third victory of the season.
author: LokkeeVerse Editorial
content: Spanish golfer Eugenio Chacarra won the DP World India Championship by a margin of two shots. The victory marks the fourth career DP World Tour title for the 26-year-old, as well as his third tournament win of the season. Following the result, Chacarra also moved into the lead in the rankings for the tour championship, according to reports from Hindustan Times.
